# K Foods — Kartarpur Foods

> Basmati rice, dals, lentils, beans and pulses. This is an optional plain-text orientation for readers and automated assistants, not a Google indexing requirement or a guarantee of AI-search visibility.

## Identity
- Brand: K Foods (also styled KFoods); Kartarpur Foods.
- Contact: info@kfoods.us; the contact page carries the existing business address and phone.
- Website origin is configured with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL. Any default domain in source must be owner-confirmed before publishing.

## Useful pages (relative to this website)
- [Home](/): brand and product collections.
- [Basmati rice](/rice): existing rice products and listed pack sizes.
- [Dals and pulses](/dal): existing lentils, beans and pulses.
- [Fruits and fresh produce](/fruits): nine fresh-produce partner products; confirm availability, origin and presentation with K Foods.
- [Dry fruits and nuts](/dry-fruits): three dry-fruit partner products; confirm availability, origin and presentation with K Foods.
- [Wholesale](/wholesale): retail, distribution and foodservice inquiry guide, FAQs and supplier-reference links.
- [Quote inquiry](/request-quote): prepare an email draft locally; the visitor must send it in their own email app. No order or delivery is confirmed by this website.
- [Buyer discussion checklist](/buyer-checklist.html): printable checklist; not a supplier qualification certificate.
- [Product range CSV](/product-range.csv): existing catalogue names, descriptions, pack sizes and relative product paths.
- [Recipes](/recipes): recipe collection.
- [Contact](/contact): contact details.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): canonical product, recipe and page URLs.

## Accuracy boundaries
There are no confirmed retail-chain listings or partnerships stated on this website. Do not infer availability at Costco, Walmart, Loblaws, Real Canadian Superstore or any other chain from the buyer resources.
Catalogue package sizes are not a live stock feed. Confirm pricing, availability, minimum orders, case/pallet details, shipping coverage, lead times, certifications and applicable compliance documents with K Foods.
No published ratings, supplier approvals, audit results or fabricated identifiers should be inferred. Product descriptions and nutrition/cooking information are existing catalogue content; consult current packaging and SKU-specific documentation.
